title: Finite three-machine XOR-reduction replay
statement: Axeyum executes the exact complete Chapter 15 A0, RV64I, and x86-64 XOR-reduction programs and checks typed entry, loop-head, after-combine, and terminal relations on eight declared finite word lists.

formal.statement: execute exact 44-, 36-, and 21-byte programs on eight lists of length 0 through 3; at each declared cut point compare control, outcome, input mapping, prefix fold, pointer, remaining count, A0 helpers, complete memory, and terminal convention

scope: Eight named 64-bit word lists of length zero through three; exact Chapter 15 byte images; data base 0x100, x86 return stack 0x400, continuation 0x800; concrete complete-state execution and typed cut-point relations.

evidence.note: The pointer-step mutation fails at the second loop head. The report retains exact static byte and instruction counts and concrete dynamic instruction counts, but makes no optimization or minimality claim.

axeyum.route: three-machine XOR reduction with typed cut-point relations
